data.title: 史黛菈 · 新婚套房床榻的极乐沉沦
data.description: 豪华双人套房白色大床上，黑色半透睡裙凌乱推在腰间。红莲皇女眼角泛着极致欢愉的泪光，十指紧紧深嵌你的后背，在滚烫颠簸中带着哭腔轻喘宣誓永远属于你。
data.location: luxury honeymoon master suite with white linen
data.action: tangled in rumpled sheets, sheer black camisole pushed up, fingernails in partner back, ecstatic teary eyes, moaning breathlessly
data.lighting: intimate soft candlelight flickering across flushed bare skin
data.mood: transcendent bridal ecstasy, total emotional surrender, absolute romantic devotion
data.promptProse: Tangled in white sheets in candlelight, Stella Vermillion sheds tears of ecstasy with flushed cheeks, clinging tightly in overwhelming passion.
data.animaCaption: Stella crying tears of joy and ecstasy in a romantic candlelit bedroom.
